explication: OpenTofu is a CLI for describing infrastructure as code, planning changes, and applying them through providers. The principal workflow runs from a user command through configuration loading and planning to graph-ordered resource changes, with state tracking the managed infrastructure. The tree also shows module and provider discovery, multiple state backends, cloud execution, provisioners, and state encryption. The README establishes the product workflow; sampled source confirms CLI setup and registry operations, but does not expose the full plan/apply call chain, so uncertain wiring is omitted.
